{{Top|leg}}
'''Rennik''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who owned the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Worldhopper]]''. He was a widower who had twin sons.

==Biography==
[[9 ABY/Legends|During the time of the New Republic]], he was hired by [[Whistler]] and [[R5-G8/Legends|Gate]],<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> He was to take them from [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] space<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> to the city of [[Oradin]]<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> There the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] met with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]].<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge" />
